correctness.rationale: A cutoff logarithmic generator test is valid on compact support and converges by dominated convergence because each coordinate plane has zero measure. It yields zero conditional mean per-capita growth on every squared-amplitude fiber. The resulting three mean equations form a circulant system whose determinant is \((a+b+c)(a^2+b^2+c^2-ab-bc-ca)\), positive exactly when the positive coefficients are not all equal. Conditional orthogonality then gives the covariance and variance defects, and summing the pointwise per-capita rates gives the total-amplitude defect. The packaged exact checker independently verifies all algebraic steps and the standard parameter specialization.

originality.rationale: The strongest complete same-object open source inspected writes the exact equations and classical heteroclinic-cycle parameters and focuses on invariant planes, symmetry, equilibria, and connections; document-wide searches found no invariant-measure, moment, or covariance theorem. A later complete accessible coupled-cell review likewise treats network realization and heteroclinic switching rather than stationary conditional moments. Broader generalized Lotka–Volterra reasoning can supply global zero-average per-capita balances, so those global averages are treated as prior background rather than sufficient novelty. The accepted fiberwise conditional law is strictly stronger: it encodes every weighted identity against functions of a single squared amplitude and yields exact speed-defect covariance formulas not implied by the global mean equations.

value.rationale: The Guckenheimer–Holmes system is a canonical model of robust heteroclinic switching, where the invariant coordinate planes make boundary and fully active statistics qualitatively different. The accepted theorem supplies an exact diagnostic for the fully active regime: despite asymmetric cyclic coupling and without assuming symmetry of the measure, all three coordinate RMS amplitudes are locked to one parameter-selected value. More strongly, each squared amplitude determines the conditional mean competitor load, and the failure of deterministic load locking is quantified exactly by per-capita speed energy. This provides a natural statistical distinction between interior recurrent dynamics and the boundary heteroclinic mechanism and can be checked directly in simulations or experiments of coupled-cell realizations.
